extraction.NOTES: This document is the printed Circular No. 2464 instruction sheet dated June 18, 1928, addressed to all superintendents. It is a blank questionnaire template with no allottee-specific data filled in. It requests an alphabetical list of all Indians issued fee patents prior to 1921 without their applications, and lists 11 data points to be reported for each allottee.

correspondence.sender_title: United States Department of the Interior, Office of Indian Affairs
correspondence.subject: Fee Patent Data - Circular No. 2464
correspondence.action_requested: Prepare and forward to the Office an alphabetical list of all Indians under each superintendent's jurisdiction to whom patents in fee were issued prior to 1921, covering allotments or inherited lands during the trust period without their applications therefor. For each name provide: (1) number of allotment and date of fee patent; (2) date and manner of delivery of patent and whether receipted; (3) whether acceptance was with or without protest and if filed for record in county; (4) whether land has been sold or mortgaged by patentee or heirs; (5) if mortgaged, whether mortgage released or foreclosed and date of redemption; (6) if land sold, amount received and whether fair consideration or settlement of old debt; (7) whether any land sold for debt or taxes; (8) whether patent has been canceled; (9) if canceled, whether tax assessments or tax sales canceled or paid assessments refunded; (10) present age, mental, physical and financial condition of patentee or heirs if deceased; (11) source of Indian's support and whether Government, State or County contributed.
